source: Claude Code 2.1.302 (native build), strings of the binary; read statically, no model and no network
purpose: The hosts Claude Code's upload tools send a local file's bytes to, observed instead of assumed (interceptors/anthropic-proxy/src/upload-gate.ts UPLOAD_HOSTS; docs/design/agents/supported-agents.md §2). A unit test pins every host listed here into UPLOAD_HOSTS.

origins.note: BASE_API_URL is the OAuth config's API host; with no custom OAuth URL a request origin is trusted when it equals BASE_API_URL's origin or is in the first-party set.

DesignSync.how: every MCP call (write_files with localPath included) is a POST of /v1/design/mcp against BASE_API_URL; the tool refuses any other base URL
excerpts: if(!_f(ln().BASE_API_URL))throw Error("Claude Design is only reachable from api.anthropic.com; the current OAuth base URL is not on the first-party allowlist.");let y=await Gt.post("/v1/design/mcp",e,{auth:"none",headers:{...Ae(t),Accept:"application/json, text/event-stream","X-Anthropic-Client":"claude-cli-design-tool",
finalize_plan: directory the bundle was built into. write_files with localPath may only read files inside this directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

Artifact.how: the claude-artifacts MCP server (path /api/artifacts/mcp) hands back an upload URL per file; the client re-reads each file, checks its sha256 against the one it hashed, and PUTs the bytes to that URL, whose origin must be a trusted first-party API origin (sC/O$ below); api-staging.anthropic.com is accepted only when the service hands it out

not_carried_by_the_egress_proxy: api.anthropic.com is a model API host: the egress proxy never touches it (interceptors/net-proxy/src/egress.ts MODEL_HOST_SUFFIXES) and the launch puts it in NO_PROXY (launcher/src/services/net-proxy.ts), so these uploads leave the agent's own process with no network layer seeing them; the model-wire gate is the only check.
also_seen_not_mapped: 2.1.302 also carries client-side file attachments for claude.ai connectors (the Chrome extension's file_upload{paths}, a managed agent's start_task files): MCP tools Mandu does not map, gated by the unmapped upload leg (interceptors/anthropic-proxy/src/unmapped-upload.ts).
